findingClass: the document cycle (scraper/src/services/document-cycle.ts, primarySourceDiscovery step) runs longer than its wake budget, or two wakes' cycles overlap — the class fixed one write path in August (w177-detection-rca.md) and recurred on this path in September because no independent check re-verified cycle duration
round7Findings: cycle-overrun RCA (2026-09-06, observed 1,210-1,278s document cycles / 105-115 network calls per cycle on a Sunday)
failThreshold: any primarySourceDiscovery row in scraper_steps (created_at, duration_ms) over the last 24h with duration_ms > 25 minutes, OR two rows for different cycleIds whose [start, end) wall-clock windows overlap (checkCycleOverrun in scripts/lib/document-state-checks.mjs, unit-tested in scripts/tests/document-state-checks.test.mjs).
unverifiableWhen: the scraper_steps table is absent (migration 0033 not applied), or it has zero primarySourceDiscovery rows in the last 24h (ENABLE_DOCUMENT_STATE_MACHINE off, or the writer has not run yet).
